sessions.summary: Investigated chub-slack-bot still running after Friday stop. Root cause: PM2 autorestart:false only prevents crash-restarts; dump file (~/.pm2/dump.pm2) controls resurrect behavior. Bot persisted as 'online' in dump → pm2 resurrect would restart it. Stopped bot and ran 'pm2 save --force' to persist stopped state. PRs #133/#134 remain blocked on im:write scope.
artifacts: Board: chub-slack-bot moved to stopped status
